# War Scroll Column 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**17:1** In the seventh lot, the great hand-of-God shall subdue [Belial and al]l the angels-of-his-dominion and all the men-of

**17:2** [his lot.] [...] The holy-ones shall shine-forth [...] to pursue [...] in a destruction-of

**17:3** annihilation. And the priests shall blow the trumpets [...] and all the battle-lines shall spread-forth

**17:4** against them [...] and the Sons-of-Light shall shine-forth with the host-of-the-angels [...] in the truth-of-God, to strengthen

**17:5** [...] the Sons-of-Light. And they shall raise a great shout [...] and the dominion-of [...]

**17:6** shall melt, and the angels [...] shall strengthen [...] the covenant-of-God [...] in the midst of the battle [...]

**17:7** For this is the time appointed by-God to bring-low the prince-of-the-dominion-of-wickedness. And He shall send

**17:8** eternal aid to the lot-of-His-redemption through the might-of-the-angel — He has made-glorious the authority-of-Michael

**17:9** in eternal light, to light-up with joy the covenant-of-Israel, peace and blessing for the lot-of-God, to exalt

**17:10** the authority-of-Michael among the gods and the dominion-of-Israel among all flesh.

**17:11** And righteousness shall rejoice in the heights, and all the sons-of-His-truth shall be-glad in eternal knowledge.

**17:12** And you, Sons-of-His-covenant, be-strong in the testing-of-God, until He waves-His-hand

**17:13** and fills His testings — the mystery-of-His-deeds. [...] And at the appointed-time He shall bring-low forever

**17:14** the Sons-of-Darkness; and there shall be no remnant and there shall be no survivor for the Sons-of

**17:15** Darkness. [...] And the righteous shall shine forth [...] unto all the appointed-times-of

**17:16** eternity. [...] and the dominion-of-the-Kittim shall come-to-an-end, wickedness shall be vanquished without

**17:17** [rem]nant, and there shall be no survivor for all the Sons-of-Darkness [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 17 describes the seventh and final lot (engagement) where God intervenes decisively. The angel Michael's role is central (17:7-10). Construct chains hyphenated. "Kittim" preserved untranslated as a Qumran cipher for the occupying power. Belial preserved as a proper noun. Lacunae follow Yadin's standard edition.*
